Hi Maya — thanks for flagging and for the screenshot.

Quick background: our demo scheduler sometimes attaches a Meet link by default when the organizer is an external calendar; engineering also included a Zoom fallback for customers that prefer Zoom. It sounds like the Meet link is created by OrchidTech's organizer settings (your side) and the Zoom instance is hosted under a different Redwood account, which explains the host passcode request.

Options:
- I can transfer host to one of your attendees (recommended) — I will request host claim via Zoom and then give access to john.patel@orchidtech.com.
- Alternatively, we can reissue a new invite with only the Zoom link and a temporary passcode that I control (less ideal for your org's SSO).
- Or switch fully to Meet (I can remove the Zoom fallback) if OrchidTech wants Google-hosted join.

Kimberly / Logan: can one of you take the host-transfer action now? If not, I can create a clean single-link invite and resend (will require a quick reschedule acceptance).

Alex Martinez
